title.en: Energy and momentum of electromagnetic waves

hook.en: Light warms your hand, so it carries *energy*. Space agencies have flown solar sails pushed only by sunlight, so it must carry momentum too.
hook.kn: ಬೆಳಕು ಕೈಯನ್ನು ಬೆಚ್ಚಗಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅದು ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತಿದೆ. ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಬೆಳಕಿನಿಂದಲೇ ತಳ್ಳಲ್ಪಡುವ ಸೌರ ಹಾಯಿಗಳಿವೆ; ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅದು ಸಂವೇಗವನ್ನೂ ಹೊತ್ತಿದೆ.

title.en: Relate energy and momentum of an EM wave
Find radiation pressure for absorbing and reflecting surfaces

say.en: Light warms your hand, so it carries energy. Space agencies have flown solar sails pushed only by sunlight, so it must carry momentum too. In this lesson: Relate energy and momentum of an EM wave.
Find radiation pressure for absorbing and reflecting surfaces.

body.en: An EM wave carries *energy* in both its fields. The energy densities $\tfrac12\varepsilon_0E^2$ and $B^2/2\mu_0$ are equal on average. The intensity, the energy crossing unit area per second, is $I = \tfrac12 c\varepsilon_0 E_0^2$.
body.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ಕಾಂತೀಯ ತರಂಗದ ಶಕ್ತಿ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಂತ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮವಾಗಿ ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ತೀವ್ರತೆ I = ½cε₀E₀².

narration.en: An EM wave carries energy in both its fields. The energy densities \tfrac12\varepsilon_0E^2 and B^2/2\mu_0 are equal on average. The intensity, the energy crossing unit area per second, is I = \tfrac12 c\varepsilon_0 E_0^2.
narration.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ಕಾಂತೀಯ ತರಂಗದ ಶಕ್ತಿ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಂತ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮವಾಗಿ ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ತೀವ್ರತೆ I = ½cε₀E₀².

say.en: An EM wave carries energy in both its fields. The energy densities \tfrac12\varepsilon 0E^2 and B^2 over 2\mu 0 are equal on average. The intensity, the energy crossing unit area per second, is I = \tfrac12 c\varepsilon 0 E 0 to the power 2. u E equals u B on average.
say.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ಕಾಂತೀಯ ತರಂಗದ ಶಕ್ತಿ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಂತ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮವಾಗಿ ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ತೀವ್ರತೆ I equals one half c epsilon 0E 0 squared.

say.en: Intensity I equals one half c epsilon 0E 0 squared.

title.en: Board: energy and pressure of light

narration.en: Let us see how much energy a wave carries and how hard it pushes.

say.en: The energy of an EM wave is stored in both fields, and on average the two shares are equal.
Intensity is energy density times speed: half c epsilon-nought E-nought squared.
A wave carrying energy U also carries momentum U by c. Absorbed light gives pressure I by c; reflected light gives twice that.
Sunlight of 1000 watt per square metre fully absorbed pushes with only about 3.3 micropascal.
Let us see how much energy a wave carries and how hard it pushes.

narration.en: An EM wave carries momentum as well as energy: energy U delivers momentum U/c. A fully absorbing surface feels pressure I/c; a perfect mirror gets twice that, 2I/c, because the light bounces back. Sunlight near the Earth is about 1000 W/m² at the ground.
narration.kn: ಬೆಳಕು ತಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ: ವಿಕಿರಣ ಒತ್ತಡ. ಸ್ಲೈಡರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸರಿಸಿ, ಓದುಗಳು ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ಗಮನಿಸಿ.

caption.en: An EM wave carries momentum as well as energy: energy U delivers momentum U/c. A fully absorbing surface feels pressure I/c; a perfect mirror gets twice that, 2I/c, because the light bounces back. Sunlight near the Earth is about 1000 W/m² at the ground.
caption.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ಕಾಂತೀಯ ತರಂಗ ಶಕ್ತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂವೇಗವನ್ನೂ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ: U ಶಕ್ತಿ U/c ಸಂವೇಗ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಪೂರ್ಣ ಹೀರುವ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ I/c ಒತ್ತಡ ಅನುಭವಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣ ದರ್ಪಣ ಎರಡರಷ್ಟು 2I/c, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಬೆಳಕು ಹಿಂದಿರುಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಭೂಮಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಬೆಳಕು ಸುಮಾರು 1000 W/m².

say.en: An EM wave carries momentum as well as energy: energy U delivers momentum U over c. A fully absorbing surface feels pressure I over c; a perfect mirror gets twice that, 2I/c, because the light bounces back. Sunlight near the Earth is about 1000 watts per square metre at the ground.

body.en: A wave that delivers energy $U$ to a surface also delivers momentum $p = U/c$ if it is completely absorbed. If it is completely reflected, the momentum delivered is $2U/c$. So light exerts a *radiation pressure* $I/c$ on an absorbing surface and $2I/c$ on a perfect reflector.
body.kn: ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಹೀರಿಕೊಂಡರೆ ಸಂವೇಗ p = U/c; ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಿಸಿದರೆ 2U/c. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಬೆಳಕು ವಿಕಿರಣ ಒತ್ತಡವನ್ನು ಬೀರುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: A wave that delivers energy U to a surface also delivers momentum p = U/c if it is completely absorbed. If it is completely reflected, the momentum delivered is 2U/c. So light exerts a radiation pressure I/c on an absorbing surface and 2I/c on a perfect reflector.
narration.kn: ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಹೀರಿಕೊಂಡರೆ ಸಂವೇಗ p = U/c; ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಿಸಿದರೆ 2U/c. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಬೆಳಕು ವಿಕಿರಣ ಒತ್ತಡವನ್ನು ಬೀರುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: A wave that delivers energy U to a surface also delivers momentum p equals U over c if it is completely absorbed. If it is completely reflected, the momentum delivered is 2U/c. So light exerts a radiation pressure I over c on an absorbing surface and 2I/c on a perfect reflector. Absorber: p equals U over c, pressure equals I over c.
say.kn: ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಹೀರಿಕೊಂಡರೆ ಸಂವೇಗ p equals U over c; ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಿಸಿದರೆ 2U/c. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಬೆಳಕು ವಿಕಿರಣ ಒತ್ತಡವನ್ನು ಬೀರುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Reflector: p equals 2U/c, pressure equals 2I/c.

problem.en: Sunlight of intensity 1.4 kW/m² falls normally on a 2 m² black (fully absorbing) plate. Find the force on the plate.

steps.en: Force = rate of momentum delivered = P/c = 2800/(3 × 10⁸).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Sunlight of intensity 1.4 kW/m² falls normally on a 2 m² black (fully absorbing) plate. Find the force on the plate.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Sunlight of intensity 1.4 kilowatts per square metre falls normally on a 2 square metres black fully absorbing plate. Find the force on the plate.
Power received equals IA equals 1400 times 2 equals 2800 watts.
Force equals rate of momentum delivered equals P over c equals 2800 over (3 times 10 to the power 8).
F is approximately 9.3 times 10 to the power minus 6 newtons.
So the answer is is approximately 9.3 times 10 to the power minus 6 newtons.

problem.en: A pulse of light carrying 3 J of energy is completely absorbed by a surface. How much momentum does it deliver?

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A pulse of light carrying 3 J of energy is completely absorbed by a surface. How much momentum does it deliver?

say.en: Let us solve this together. A pulse of light carrying 3 joules of energy is completely absorbed by a surface. How much momentum does it deliver?
p equals U over c equals 3 over (3 times 10 to the power 8).
p equals 1 times 10 to the power minus 8 kilograms metres per second.
So the answer is 1 times 10 to the power minus 8 kilograms metres per second.
